::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Full name Aryabhata Circuits and Research Labs (ABCRL). Founded 2019 in Bengaluru by Rajesh Jagasia, later joined by semiconductor veteran Tushar K. Bhattacharyya. Also backed by MeitY's Chips-to-Startup (C2S) scheme.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Tire Synapse, a tire-monitoring ASIC with integrated Bluetooth for tire-wear prediction, road-condition detection, load detection, and wheel-alignment/balance assessment in vehicles.
